messages:
leah: Canary deploy finished at 10:20 PT for rev redwood/runtime@v3.2.1. Kicking off an "afterburn" quick verification — small smoke list below, please ping when done and call rollback if anything critical.

matt: on it. I can run the endpoint health + a few sample long prompts. Will post results in ~5m. @leah do we want the synthetic load run or keep it light?

leah: keep it light for now — basic sanity + latency guards. synthetic load later if canary looks OK.

devops-bot: deploy succeeded: service=runtime-canary image=redwood/runtime:v3.2.1 cluster=us-west-2-canary commit=8f4a2b.

matt: running checks:
```
# health
curl -sS -D- -o /dev/null https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/health
# gen quick
curl -sS -X POST https://canary.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt": "hello"}' | jq .
```
Posting brief results in a sec.

ci-bot: smoke-run: job/afterburn-1769001234 started, outputs at https://ci.redwood.ai/afterburn/1769001234

matt: results: health=200, p50=42ms, p95=112ms, error_rate=0.4% (baseline 0.3%). One warning in logs about cache eviction but no 5xx. Full log excerpt pasted into the CI link.

priya: I checked infra metrics: GPU utilization for canary nodes normal ~56%. KV cache miss rate spiked during one minute (x3) but returned to baseline. No backend 500s in last 10m. Dashboard snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/xyz123

jamal: saw a short-lived worker reconnect in logs and a slew of WARN: "kv-cache miss for session" at 10:21:10. Not seeing app exceptions, might be transient. Flagging because it lines up with the small error bump.

leah: thanks. Do we want to keep canary at 5% or roll to 20% now? Is rollback staged?

matt: leaning to hold at 5% for 15m to watch p95 and error trend. Rollback is ready: tag=redwood/runtime:rollback-v3.2.0, rollback job is queued (ops job id 9872). Command to rollback (ops-run):
```
./opsctl rollback --service runtime --to-tag redwood/runtime:rollback-v3.2.0 --env canary
```

priya: +1 to hold. I'll set an alert if error_rate > 1% or p95 > 250ms for more than 2min.

jamal: if we do need to rollback, note that cache warming will be slower on the older image; expect a transient p95 bump for ~3 min post-rollback.

matt: marking my checks: endpoints ok, a couple of spiky traces but nothing actionable. no rollback from me. :thumbsup:

leah: OK holding at 5% and watching. @priya can you gate the 20% increase when alerts clear?

priya: yup will hold off until 15:45 PT or until metrics stable for 10m, whichever is later.

ci-bot: smoke-run: job/afterburn-1769001234 finished — status=complete, critical_failures=0, warnings=1. Report: https://ci.redwood.ai/afterburn/1769001234/report

leah: great — thanks everyone. If nothing critical in the next 15m, I'll post a follow-up to expand to 20%. Leaving this thread open for any quick fixes.

jamal: noted. I'll keep an eye on kv-miss alarms and will ping here if it reoccurs.

matt: done from my side, moving to monitoring.

leah: closing in 15m if no changes. Thanks all. :rocket:
